defmodule AuthToken do
  @moduledoc """
  JWT authentication token handler with RS256/HS256 support.
  Uses constant-time comparison for HMAC verification.
  """

  @allowed_algorithms ["RS256", "HS256"]
  @token_ttl 3600

  defmodule Config do
    defstruct [:rsa_public_key, :hmac_secret, :issuer]
  end

  def verify_token(token, %Config{} = config) do
    with {:ok, header, payload, signature} <- decode_parts(token),
         :ok <- check_algorithm(header),
         :ok <- verify_signature(header, token, config),
         :ok <- check_claims(payload, config) do
      {:ok, payload}
    end
  end

  defp decode_parts(token) do
    case String.split(token, ".") do
      [header_b64, payload_b64, sig_b64] ->
        with {:ok, header_json} <- Base.url_decode64(header_b64, padding: false),
             {:ok, header} <- Jason.decode(header_json),
             {:ok, payload_json} <- Base.url_decode64(payload_b64, padding: false),
             {:ok, payload} <- Jason.decode(payload_json),
             {:ok, signature} <- Base.url_decode64(sig_b64, padding: false) do
          {:ok, header, payload, signature}
        else
          _ -> {:error, :invalid_encoding}
        end
      [header_b64, payload_b64] ->
        with {:ok, header_json} <- Base.url_decode64(header_b64, padding: false),
             {:ok, header} <- Jason.decode(header_json),
             {:ok, payload_json} <- Base.url_decode64(payload_b64, padding: false),
             {:ok, payload} <- Jason.decode(payload_json) do
          {:ok, header, payload, ""}
        else
          _ -> {:error, :invalid_encoding}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp check_algorithm(%{"alg" => alg}) when alg in @allowed_algorithms, do: :ok
  defp check_algorithm(%{"alg" => _}), do: {:error, :unsupported_algorithm}
  defp check_algorithm(_), do: {:error, :missing_algorithm}

  defp verify_signature(%{"alg" => "RS256"}, token, %Config{rsa_public_key: pub_key}) do
    [header_b64, payload_b64 | _] = String.split(token, ".")
    signing_input = header_b64 <> "." <> payload_b64
    sig_b64 = List.last(String.split(token, "."))
    {:ok, signature} = Base.url_decode64(sig_b64, padding: false)
    
    case :public_key.verify(signing_input, :sha256, signature, pub_key) do
      true -> :ok
      false -> {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp verify_signature(%{"alg" => "HS256"}, token, %Config{hmac_secret: secret}) do
    [header_b64, payload_b64 | _] = String.split(token, ".")
    signing_input = header_b64 <> "." <> payload_b64
    sig_b64 = List.last(String.split(token, "."))
    {:ok, signature} = Base.url_decode64(sig_b64, padding: false)
    
    expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, secret, signing_input)
    
    case secure_compare(expected, signature) do
      true -> :ok
      false -> {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp verify_signature(%{"alg" => _alg}, _token, _config) do
    # Algorithm already validated by check_algorithm/1
    # This clause handles any future additions gracefully
    :ok
  end

  defp check_claims(payload, config) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    
    with :ok <- verify_expiry(payload, now),
         :ok <- verify_issuer(payload, config.issuer),
         :ok <- verify_not_before(payload, now) do
      :ok
    end
  end

  defp verify_expiry(%{"exp" => exp}, now) when is_integer(exp) do
    if now < exp, do: :ok, else: {:error, :token_expired}
  end
  defp verify_expiry(_, _), do: {:error, :missing_expiry}

  defp verify_issuer(%{"iss" => iss}, expected_issuer) do
    if secure_compare(iss, expected_issuer), do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_issuer}
  end
  defp verify_issuer(_, _), do: {:error, :missing_issuer}

  defp verify_not_before(%{"nbf" => nbf}, now) when is_integer(nbf) do
    if now >= nbf, do: :ok, else: {:error, :token_not_yet_valid}
  end
  defp verify_not_before(_, _), do: :ok

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    if byte_size(a) != byte_size(b) do
      false
    else
      secure_compare_bytes(a, b, 0)
    end
  end
  defp secure_compare(a, b), do: secure_compare(to_string(a), to_string(b))

  defp secure_compare_bytes(<<>>, <<>>, acc), do: acc == 0
  defp secure_compare_bytes(<<a, rest_a::binary>>, <<b, rest_b::binary>>, acc) do
    import Bitwise
    secure_compare_bytes(rest_a, rest_b, acc ||| bxor(a, b))
  end
end
